question: State legal provider name, performing facility and responsible technical contact.
State BID or NO BID for each M01-M05 method; do not bundle unbid methods.
Acknowledge unpowered/unconnected work, no encoder access and no fabrication/safety/energization approval.
Describe receiving, quarantine, segregation, photos, custody, insurance and return controls.
List proposed equipment by maker/model/serial, software/version and performing facility.
Provide calibration certificates/due dates/traceability for every result-producing instrument and artifact.
Provide current ISO/IEC 17025 certificate/scope and map each quoted result inside or outside scope; ISO 9001 alone is not sufficient.
Identify every subcontracted activity, facility and data transfer.
Confirm native/raw files, CSV results, transforms, residuals, processing logs, scale-bearing photos and SHA-256-compatible delivery.
Provide method-specific uncertainty budgets, coverage factors, distributions, sensitivities and reporting rule; do not substitute resolution for uncertainty.
Price methods separately with fixed/not-to-exceed assumptions, fixture development, shipping, insurance, tax, witness, lead time and expiration.
Describe discrepancy, damage, unexpected contact/force, nonconformance, stop-work and quarantine rules.
Propose loose-part depth/face/feature-coordinate measurands and datum construction without inferring thread function.
Propose nonmarring free-state support and prove measured features remain accessible and unbiased.
Define probe strategy, reseat/repeat series, environmental controls and raw point retention.
State deliverable coordinate system, point/features, fit algorithms, residuals and uncertainty.
Propose external construction of the output-to-idler joint axis from exact received features/artifacts and state fit algorithms/residuals.
Acknowledge no screw insertion until a separately signed exact hardware/torque/reuse instruction is supplied.
Propose support/restraint leaving outer faces and axis features accessible without loading case, connector or unapproved threads.
Define axial measurands, transforms, repetitions and uncertainty.
Propose calibrated external angle reference; actuator encoder data are prohibited.
Propose independent gravity restraint/counterbalance and allowed operator-force measurement.
Define bidirectional hand-position sequence, repetitions, reversal rule and stop-work force threshold.
Define backlash estimator, raw angles/forces, hysteresis representation and uncertainty.
State scanner/model/serial, point spacing, verified volumetric error and calibration artifact over this article size.
Propose at least two low-occlusion orientations and supports; the P0.2 frame may not be the sole fixture.
Define fiducials/reference artifact, transform chain, registration algorithm, residual reporting and independent check.
Provide raw scans/point clouds, trimmed/untrimmed data, meshes, transforms, logs and screening-only uncertainty.
State balance maker/model/serial, range, resolution, calibration and location.
Define tray/container tare, stability, zero checks and air-current/temperature controls.
Define loose-article and frozen assembled-stack identity/repetition records.
Provide raw readings, corrections, repetitions and uncertainty in grams.

Acknowledge the exact attachment hashes; describe how every received feature will be matched to the 79 source signatures and how missing, extra, inaccessible or nonmatching features will be reported without substitution.
